sprite.leftHint: The main prompt, characters and art style on the left are the character's look and go into every variant. Poses, outfit and expressions are set in Definition.

sprite.intro: A sprite set holds one character's variant sprites. Start with New set and pick a template.
sprite.saveTemplate: Save the definition as a template
sprite.deleteSetBody: The definition, adoptions and candidate lists are removed. Generated images stay in the project history.

blank.name: Blank
blank.desc: One pose with clothes / face regions

methodLong.inpaint: Inpaints the axis' regions of the parent's adopted image
methodLong.composite: Pastes the single-axis cell's region onto the parent's adopted image (no Anlas)

blocker.orphan: This cell's axis or level no longer exists in the definition.
blocker.parentNotAdopted: The parent cell has no adopted image. Make and adopt it first (batches do this automatically).
blocker.sourceNotAdopted: The composite source (the single-axis cell) has no adopted image.
blocker.maskMissing: The region masks of this pose are not drawn yet.
blocker.noRegion: This axis has no region. Pick one in Definition → axes.

matrix.noPoses: No poses. Add them in Definition.
matrix.costBody: Making {{cells}} cells costs about {{count}} Anlas. Continue?
matrix.tileHint: Click to select, double-click to generate

cell.noSelection: Select a cell in the matrix to see how it is made, its candidates and prompt.
cell.retouchHint: Regenerate only a painted part of this image
cell.promptNote: Goes after the main prompt, before the quality tags.
cell.notePlaceholder: e.g. the sword in the right hand tends to vanish

define.settingsHint: Size and seed are shared by the set (the header's size and seed are not used). A fixed seed keeps face and clothes closer across poses.
define.sizeWarning: Changing the size after generating shifts inpainting and compositing.
define.posesHint: Each pose's base is generated from its prompt; every variant derives from it.
define.posePlaceholder: e.g. full body, standing, fighting stance
define.regionsHint: Named masks drawn per pose. An axis only repaints inside its regions. Regions that don't overlap (face, clothes) can be combined by compositing.
define.outfitHint: Describe the outfit part by part so every variant wears the same clothes. Parts worn under others (underwear) stay out of the prompt until a part over them is torn open or gone.
define.partPlaceholder: e.g. navy blue jacket with gold trim, long sleeves
define.coveredByHint: Make this part hidden under the selected parts
define.hiddenPart: Left out of the prompt until a part over it is torn open or gone.
define.noParts: No parts (not needed without a clothing-damage axis)
define.stagesHint: Pick each part's state per stage. Torn / torn open add torn / heavily torn automatically; write your own wording in the field below if you prefer.
define.axesHint: Derived top to bottom: a cell is made from the cell with its last changed axis one level lower, by inpainting that axis' regions.
define.chainHint: On: level n is made from level n-1 (progressing damage). Off: every level from level 0
define.compositeHint: Cells combined with other axes are made by pixel compositing (no Anlas). Only when the regions don't overlap other axes'
define.label: Label
define.keyHint: Letters / digits used in exported file names

mask.noImage: This pose's base has no adopted image yet. Generate or import it first to paint over it.
mask.hintRegions: Painted in 8px cells (what the API uses). Make clothes a little wider than what may tear; for the face, cover eyes and mouth without the hair.
mask.hintCustom: Only the painted area is inpainted with this cell's prompt.

export.layersHint: Export variants as transparent PNGs holding only their difference from the base
export.layersNote: Variants become overlays for the base; outside the axis regions they are transparent.

generic.name: Generic / own engine
generic.desc: PNGs plus manifest.json / manifest.csv mapping pose and axis levels to files — ready for browser games and custom engines.

rpgmaker-mz.name: RPG Maker MZ
rpgmaker-mz.desc: Images in img/pictures and a plugin in js/plugins that shows the sprite chosen by variables (plugin command "Show sprite").

rpgmaker-mv.name: RPG Maker MV
rpgmaker-mv.desc: Images in img/pictures and a plugin (plugin command: NaiSprite_Name show id x y).

wolf.name: WOLF RPG Editor
wolf.desc: Images in Data/Picture, a CSV for the user database and a readme.

tyrano.name: TyranoScript
tyrano.desc: Images in data/fgimage/chara and a .ks with chara_new / chara_face (chara_layer with difference layers).

kirikiri.name: KiriKiri Z (KAG)
kirikiri.desc: Images in fgimage and a .ks macro that shows a sprite by id.

renpy.name: Ren'Py
renpy.desc: Images in game/images and an .rpy with image statements (Composite with difference layers). show name pose axis_level …

unity.name: Unity
unity.desc: Images and manifest in Assets/NaiSprites plus NaiSpriteLibrary.cs to get a Sprite by id.

godot.name: Godot
godot.desc: Images in sprites plus a GDScript that loads a texture by id.

unreal.name: Unreal Engine
unreal.desc: Images in Sprites and a CSV for a DataTable.

web-atlas.name: Web (Phaser / PixiJS)
web-atlas.desc: Trimmed texture atlases (TexturePacker JSON Hash, more pages when needed) and manifest.json.
